analysis: Examined base_text lines 1-794 of docs/provider/cli-reference.md. The file_changes map (range_map_complete=true) shows the actual changes are outside these units: head 1804-1810 adds documentation that `darkbloom update` on a cluster Mac asks the cluster service supervisor to restart into the installed release with the paired Mac after drain, bounded by --timeout, with a deferral exiting 1. Head 2148 changes the description of `[provider] auto_update` to cover the pair's coordinated update at its update slot. Base 2141 is the old auto_update row. These are documentation-only changes. The excerpted update text still says bundle, binary and mlx.metallib hashes are verified before replacement (SelfUpdater.swift), so it does not weaken the T-013/T-043 update-integrity assumptions. The new behavior is a cross-Mac coordinated restart via the cluster supervisor: a local IPC or peer channel that can trigger restarts. That is potential new availability surface (TB-003/T-043 style DoS, A-018). However, UpdateCommand.swift (ClusterServiceUpdateRequest) and the supervisor source are not supplied, so no regression can be established from the docs. Integration should check: (1) whether the supervisor's update request channel is authenticated or owner-only; (2) whether the peer Mac can force a restart or a downgrade; (3) whether the hash verification also applies to the peer's installed release. Nothing in the visible units touches the T-041 cache, logout, or attestation semantics.
